items.title: Trump Media sells another 2,628 BTC, holdings fall to 4,261 BTC
items.snippet: Trump Media transferred another 2,628 Bitcoin to Crypto.com, bringing its reported sales over seven months to 7,281 BTC and leaving the company with 4,261 BTC in holdings.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо BTC -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: Coldcard hack sparks biggest sub-1 BTC move since FTX: CryptoQuant
items.snippet: Bitcoin users moved 39,600 BTC in small transactions as the Coldcard hack continued, with researchers warning that the attack remained active.
items.note: Негативний тон для BTC за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.
